name: Fairy Glade
source: Taking a walk in the woods has never been a problem before, but this time will lead Daphne into an alternate realm of existence. The fairy glade, but can she find her way back out again and if she does what adventures will she have along the way, your choices will determine her path and what may come.
translation: 以前在树林里散步从来都不是问题，但这一次将带领达芙妮进入另一个存在领域。仙女空地，但她能再次找到出去的路吗？如果她做了什么，她一路上会经历什么冒险，你的选择将决定她的道路和可能发生的事情。
